verdict.rationale: Spline's pricing page lists a "Team Library" feature, which suggests some shared library across a team, but nothing describes what it publishes or how. The documented Components feature only reuses objects within a single scene, with instances auto-updating when the main component changes, not across files or projects. missing for 10: documentation that Team Library publishes components and styles across files/projects, any controlled or opt-in update/accept-changes mechanism when the source changes, shared styles/tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes

citations.quote: Components are objects that can be reused multiple times throughout your scene and whenever there are changes made to the main component all instances will update accordingly.
